meta.name: bullet-proof-business-plan
meta.description: Stress-test and strengthen a business plan through iterative rounds of adversarial investor critique and strategic re-engineering. Use when you need to identify existential risks in a business model and transform vulnerabilities into defensible moats. Do NOT use for creative writing, general notes, or non-business strategies.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过投资人视角的压力测试，强化你的商业计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在撰写商业计划书并希望提前发现致命漏洞
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test and strengthen your business plan through adversarial investor critique
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are writing a business plan and want to identify critical flaws before pitching

howto.what: Claude 会反复审查你的商业计划书，扮演投资人提出尖锐质疑，然后帮你修改计划，直到它更经得起推敲。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 对一份商业计划书执行“bulletproof”流程时触发。

say.text: 运行 bulletproof 流程，针对我的商业计划书。
say.note: Claude 会开始多轮审查和修改。

say.text: 请对这份计划书执行 3 轮强化。
say.note: 指定轮数，Claude 会按此执行。

howto.what_en: Claude will iteratively review your business plan as an adversarial investor, identify objections, then help you revise the plan to address them, making it more robust.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to run the 'bulletproof' process on a business plan file.

say_en.text: Run the bulletproof process on my business plan.
say_en.note: Claude will start multi-round review and revision.

say_en.text: Execute 3 rounds of hardening on this plan.
